note: Planted ground truth for the demo fixtures. Each cluster is a set of record ids that are the same person; ids from the CSV id column are namespaced by source (existing: or incoming:). All within-cluster pairs are true duplicates; everything else is a true non-duplicate. The two same-name, different-DOB look-alikes (E008/N007 and the non-paired Marias) are NOT here on purpose: one is a genuine non-duplicate, and E002/N004 IS a duplicate with a DOB typo, so the matcher must send those to review rather than guess.
